"""Main-owned pristine builds; no device, profiler or model launch."""
import argparse
import fcntl
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
from pathlib import Path

B = Path('/home/yayoi/.local/state/strata-sycl/post-reboot-tuning-20261007')
X = Path('/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/MistVVK/XeStrata/.worktree/fix-xestrata-e32-host-handoff-20261011')
LLVM = X / '.tools/intel-llvm-v711/install'
G = Path('/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/.worktree/dep-ggml-3cf-xe-e32-20261011')
O = B / 'xe-llvm-v711-source-v5/direct_owner.py'
assert hashlib.sha256(O.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == 'a29d8257eecc77c4ad9ae6671d092b56f4c09a35c4247c125fed3a8c8bc1f95f'
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('pristine_build_owner', O)
m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(m)

def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('--phase', choices=['official'], required=True)
    phase = parser.parse_args().phase
    official = phase == 'official'
    W = (Path('/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/Niko1221/Strata/.worktree/bench-upstream-v0143-pristine-20261012')
         if official else Path('/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/MistVVK/XeStrata/.worktree/bench-xestrata-xe0142-pristine-20261012'))
    expected = '7695859aa13afb248bdb4d36f9b2e95707db079d' if official else 'da3d426079019daa6e01388d03b0d94ae67070b7'
    IC = Path('/opt/intel/oneapi/compiler/2026.1')
    env = dict(PATH=str(IC / 'bin') + ':/usr/bin:/bin', HOME='/home/yayoi', USER='yayoi', LOGNAME='yayoi',
               LANG='C.UTF-8', LC_ALL='C.UTF-8', LD_LIBRARY_PATH=str(IC / 'lib') + ':/opt/intel/oneapi/mkl/2026.1/lib',
               MKLROOT='/opt/intel/oneapi/mkl/2026.1')
    with (B / 'owned-v0141-measurement.lock').open('a') as lock:
        fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
        out = B / ('latest-update-pristine-' + phase + '-icpx-build-root-v2')
        m.require(not out.exists(), 'fresh receipt')
        out.mkdir(mode=0o700)
        r = dict(active=True, complete=False, passed=False, phase=phase, started_utc=m.utc(),
                 controller_sha256=m.sha(__file__), owner_sha256=m.sha(O), commands=[], environment=env,
                 source_patch_applied=False, source_tree=str(W), gpu_executed=False, model_executed=False,
                 performance_measured=False, raw_log_budget_bytes=64 << 20)
        def save(): (out / 'record.json').write_text(json.dumps(r, indent=2) + '\n')
        owner = m.Owner(out / 'commands', save)
        r['commands'] = owner.commands
        def cmd(label, argv, wall=60):
            c, so, se = owner.run(label, argv, env, W, wall=wall, cpu=wall*4, text_cap=64 << 20,
                                  total_cap=64 << 20, file_cap=16 << 30, rss_cap=80 << 30)
            r.setdefault('evidence', {})[label] = dict(stdout=so.read_text(), stderr=se.read_text())
            save()
            m.require(m.closed(c) and c['session_anchored'] and c['exit_code'] == 0, label + ' normal anchored success')
            return so.read_text()
        try:
            cp = B / 'xe-llvm-v711-source-root-v5/record.json'
            tc = json.loads(cp.read_text())
            m.require(tc['passed'] and tc['complete'] and not tc['active'], 'qualified compiler')
            m.require(all(m.sha(Path(i['path'])) == i['sha256'] for i in tc['installed_files'].values()), 'compiler identities')
            r['qualified_source_llvm_reference_sha256'] = m.sha(cp)
            r['compiler_mode'] = 'official recommended icpx, independent of candidate free/contrib-llvm'
            r['compiler_installed_pins'] = {str(p): m.sha(p) for p in [IC / 'bin/icx', IC / 'bin/icpx', IC / 'lib/libsycl.so.9']}
            r['compiler_version'] = cmd('compiler-version', [str(IC / 'bin/icpx'), '--version'])
            r['revision'] = cmd('head', ['/usr/bin/git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD']).strip()
            m.require(r['revision'] == expected, 'latest immutable release')
            m.require(not cmd('status-before', ['/usr/bin/git', 'status', '--porcelain']).strip(), 'pristine clean')
            files = cmd('source-list', ['/usr/bin/git', 'ls-files']).splitlines()
            r['source_pins'] = {p: m.sha(W / p) for p in files if (W / p).is_file()}
            m.require(cmd('ggml-head', ['/usr/bin/git', '-C', str(G), 'rev-parse', 'HEAD']).strip()
                      == '3cf03257f219afbe7334045ff7c6a06ac68c627d', 'GGML pin')
            m.require(not cmd('ggml-status', ['/usr/bin/git', '-C', str(G), 'status', '--porcelain']).strip(), 'GGML clean')
            build = W / 'build' / ('official-sycl-icpx' if official else phase.removeprefix('xe-'))
            m.require(not build.exists(), 'fresh pristine build')
            opts = ['-DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release', '-DCMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS=ON',
                    '-DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=' + str(IC / 'bin/icx'),
                    '-DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=' + str(IC / 'bin/icpx'), '-DSTRATA_GGML_DIR=' + str(G)]
            if official:
                opts += ['-DSTRATA_SYCL_PARITY=OFF', '-DSTRATA_SYCL_AOT=']
            else:
                free = phase == 'xe-free'
                opts += ['-DSTRATA_LICENSE=' + ('free' if free else 'contrib'), '-DSTRATA_ENABLE_XE=ON',
                         '-DSTRATA_CUDA_ARCHS=', '-DSTRATA_HIP_ARCHS=', '-DSTRATA_ONEMKL=' + ('OFF' if free else 'ON'),
                         '-DSTRATA_NATIVE_EXPERTS=ON', '-DSTRATA_PORTABLE=OFF', '-DSTRATA_BUILD_TESTS=OFF']
                if not free: opts += ['-DMKL_ROOT=/opt/intel/oneapi/mkl/2026.1']
            cmd('configure', ['/usr/bin/cmake', '-S', str(W / 'sycl' if official else W),
                              '-B', str(build), '-G', 'Ninja', *opts], wall=900)
            r['build_recipe'] = {p: dict(path=str(build / p), bytes=(build / p).stat().st_size, sha256=m.sha(build / p))
                                 for p in ['CMakeCache.txt', 'compile_commands.json', 'build.ninja'] if (build / p).is_file()}
            cmd('compile', ['/usr/bin/nice', '-n', '10', '/usr/bin/cmake', '--build', str(build),
                            '--parallel', '4', '--target', 'strata'], wall=5400)
            r['binary'] = dict(path=str(build / 'strata'), bytes=(build / 'strata').stat().st_size,
                               sha256=m.sha(build / 'strata'))
            m.require(all(m.sha(W / p) == h for p, h in r['source_pins'].items()), 'pristine source stable')
            m.require(not cmd('status-after', ['/usr/bin/git', 'status', '--porcelain']).strip(), 'pristine still clean')
            r['passed'] = True
        except BaseException as error:
            r['error'] = repr(error)
        finally:
            r.update(active=owner.active is not None, complete=owner.active is None, finished_utc=m.utc())
            save()
        print(json.dumps({k: r.get(k) for k in ['phase', 'passed', 'error', 'binary']}))
        return 0 if r['passed'] else 1

if __name__ == '__main__':
    raise SystemExit(main())
